title: WinWinCode ExecutionPort v1
description: Transport-neutral contract between the Rust Control Plane and Rust Execution Worker.

ExecutionMessageId.description: Unique identity of one ExecutionPort message envelope.

ExecutionEventId.description: Stable identity retained when a runtime event is replayed.

ArtifactId.description: Identity of one lease-scoped execution artifact.

ModelExchangeId.description: Identity of one provider-neutral model stream exchange.

FencingToken.description: Monotonically increasing decimal token encoded as a string to preserve 64-bit precision.

predecessorSessionIdentity.description: The exact slot-bound predecessor WorkerSession and CodexThread. Null means no predecessor slot-bound runtime exists; the predecessor dispatch may have been accepted, but null authorizes neither dirty-workspace reuse nor continuation of an old runtime or Artifact stream.

ExecutionJobReplacementAuthority.description: Control Plane seal for one exact predecessor-to-successor Job replacement. The predecessor lease and optional bound session also authorize exact continuation of an already durable Artifact stream; they never authorize a new stream.

InteractiveInputChoice.description: One interactive option. id is the stable UI/business identity; value is the canonical answer submitted to the Worker.

WorkerRegisterMessage.title: worker.register
WorkerRegisterMessage.description: Registers one stable Worker identity and one process-boot identity.

WorkerRegistrationResultMessage.title: worker.registration_result
WorkerRegistrationResultMessage.description: Returns the idempotent registration result and restart lease recovery rule.

WorkerCapabilitiesMessage.title: worker.capabilities
WorkerCapabilitiesMessage.description: Replaces the registered capability snapshot for the current Worker instance.

WorkerHeartbeatMessage.title: worker.heartbeat
WorkerHeartbeatMessage.description: Reports liveness, capacity, and lease progress for one Worker instance.

WorkerHeartbeatAckMessage.title: worker.heartbeat_ack
WorkerHeartbeatAckMessage.description: Acknowledges exactly one heartbeat without dispatching jobs as a side effect.

JobDispatchMessage.title: job.dispatch
JobDispatchMessage.description: Dispatches one immutable job payload under one attempt and lease.

JobDispatchResultMessage.title: job.dispatch_result
JobDispatchResultMessage.description: Returns the idempotent result of accepting or rejecting a job dispatch.

LeaseRenewMessage.title: lease.renew
LeaseRenewMessage.description: Extends one lease for the same Worker instance, attempt, and fencing token.

RuntimeEventMessage.title: runtime.event
RuntimeEventMessage.description: Publishes one ordered, replayable, provider-neutral runtime fact.

RuntimeAckMessage.title: runtime.ack
RuntimeAckMessage.description: Acknowledges the highest contiguous runtime event and requests a gap replay when needed.

RuntimeReplayRequestMessage.title: runtime.replay_request
RuntimeReplayRequestMessage.description: Requests original runtime events strictly after the acknowledged sequence.

ArtifactOpenMessage.title: artifact.open
ArtifactOpenMessage.description: Begins a lease-scoped artifact stream without exposing an object-store implementation.

ArtifactChunkMessage.title: artifact.chunk
ArtifactChunkMessage.description: Transfers one ordered artifact chunk through either local or remote adapters.

ArtifactAckMessage.title: artifact.ack
ArtifactAckMessage.description: Acknowledges the highest contiguous artifact chunk.

ModelOpenMessage.title: model.open
ModelOpenMessage.description: Opens one provider-neutral model exchange through the Control Plane gateway.

ModelChunkMessage.title: model.chunk
ModelChunkMessage.description: Streams one opaque provider-neutral model response chunk.

ModelAckMessage.title: model.ack
ModelAckMessage.description: Acknowledges model chunks and requests replay after a stream interruption.

InputRequestMessage.title: input.request
InputRequestMessage.description: Requests one typed user input through the Control Plane product session.

InputResponseMessage.title: input.response
InputResponseMessage.description: Returns a typed input result without exposing product-session storage.

ApprovalRequestMessage.title: approval.request
ApprovalRequestMessage.description: Requests a decision for one execution action; business approval state remains Control Plane owned.

ApprovalDecisionMessage.title: approval.decision
ApprovalDecisionMessage.description: Returns the resolved execution approval decision.

JobCancelMessage.title: job.cancel
JobCancelMessage.description: Requests cooperative cancellation for the currently fenced attempt.

JobCancelAckMessage.title: job.cancel_ack
JobCancelAckMessage.description: Acknowledges cancellation without declaring a Delivery result.

JobOutcomeMessage.title: job.outcome
JobOutcomeMessage.description: Reports an execution outcome; Control Plane alone derives canonical Delivery state and verdicts.

JobOutcomeAckMessage.title: job.outcome_ack
JobOutcomeAckMessage.description: Accepts or rejects one lease-fenced execution outcome idempotently.

ExecutionPortMessage.title: ExecutionPortMessage
ExecutionPortMessage.description: The single versioned message union shared by local and remote ExecutionPort adapters.

stageRunId.description: Exact Delivery StageRun identity. ProductSession Chat bindings omit this field.

SessionBindingMessage.description: Authoritative WorkerSession-to-CodexThread binding for one exact active Job lease. Delivery-stage bindings carry the exact StageRun; ProductSession Chat bindings omit it.
SessionBindingMessage.title: session.binding

ActionPolicyKind.title: ActionPolicyKind
ActionPolicyKind.description: Enterprise Policy family selected for one normalized Worker action.

ActionEnforcementDecision.title: ActionEnforcementDecision
ActionEnforcementDecision.description: Closed Control Plane action enforcement outcome.

ActionPolicyVersionReference.title: ActionPolicyVersionReference
ActionPolicyVersionReference.description: Exact immutable enterprise Policy version used for one action decision.

ActionEnforcementRequestMessage.title: action.enforcement_request
ActionEnforcementRequestMessage.description: Requests one Control Plane Policy decision for a normalized action under current durable Worker authority.

ActionEnforcementReceiptMessage.title: action.enforcement_receipt
ActionEnforcementReceiptMessage.description: Immutable Control Plane-issued action receipt bound to tenant, actor, Policy version, invocation, action digest, and current Worker authority.

ActionPolicyMode.title: ActionPolicyMode
ActionPolicyMode.description: Enterprise Policy enforcement mode captured by an action receipt.

RoleExecutionMode.description: Role-session execution strategy. DebugProbe and delegated batch sessions are read-only; the mode is independent from the process-level Worker execution mode.

RoleSessionPolicy.description: Canonical version 2 policy applied to one role-scoped Kernel session. DebugProbe and delegated batch policies use a read-only workspace. Durable version 1 rows are migrated once with executionMode react; version 1 is not a supported runtime shape.

ChangeBatchProposalDisposition.description: Composer disposition for one bounded patch proposal.

ChangeBatchProposal.description: Bounded Composer output. The patch is capped at 512 KiB; it carries no source snapshot or log payload.

ChangeBatchIdentity.description: Replay-stable identity for one ChangeBatch. It binds the exact job attempt, lease fence, session, repository workspace revision, turn, and patch digest.

AppliedFileSummary.description: Secret-safe summary of one normalized file change. Paths are relative and source bytes remain in the Artifact store.

changedFileDigests.description: Sorted unique domain-separated digests of each Writer file change, binding path, operation, before/after content digests, byte counts, and modes without inline bytes.

NormalizerReceipt.description: Bounded receipt from deterministic patch normalization. It retains digests and Artifact references instead of patch bytes.

ValidationCheckSummary.description: One bounded, secret-safe validation check result.

ValidationReceipt.description: Bounded validation outcome with summaries and Artifact references only.

ValidationProfileName.description: Closed validation profile ladder. changed is path-scoped, fast is the bounded pre-review gate, affected expands to impacted suites, and final is the explicit full gate.

ValidationCommandLanguage.description: Supported repository language family for one validation command.

ValidationCommandPhase.description: Closed Writer kind or read-only validation phase. Writer kinds are audited separately and always run before validation.

ValidationEnvironmentName.description: Closed command environment allowlist. LANG and LC_ALL values are explicit; runtime replaces PATH, HOME, and TMPDIR from its trusted tool and scratch authority.

ValidationEnvironmentVariable.description: One bounded environment request. PATH, HOME, and TMPDIR values never select an executable or write scope and are replaced by trusted runtime values; duplicate names are rejected by the canonical parser.

allowedCompanionPaths.description: Portable repository-relative paths a Writer may change in addition to the current ChangeBatch paths; validation commands must leave this empty.

diagnosticParserVersion.description: Explicit parser for structured validation output; omitted or null means status-only output. Writer commands must omit it or use null.

ValidationCommandSpec.description: Shell-free Writer or validation command. Writer kind, parser version, and allowed companion paths are explicit; argv is capped at 256 entries and 64 KiB total by the canonical parser; network is denied.

allowedCompanionPaths.description: Portable repository-relative paths a Writer may change in addition to the current ChangeBatch paths; validation commands must leave this empty.
Portable repository-relative paths a Writer may change in addition to the current ChangeBatch paths; validation commands must leave this empty.
Portable repository-relative paths a Writer may change in addition to the current ChangeBatch paths; validation commands must leave this empty.
Portable repository-relative paths a Writer may change in addition to the current ChangeBatch paths; validation commands must leave this empty.

ValidationProfile.description: One ordered profile referencing only commands declared by the same configuration.

ValidationConfiguration.description: Canonical .winwincode/validation.toml shape. Exactly one changed, fast, affected, and final profile and at least one TypeScript, Rust, and Python command are required by the canonical parser.

ValidationSelectionSource.description: Only an explicit configuration selection is executable; automatic inference is advisory.

ValidationProfileSelection.description: Deterministic selection result. Suggestions carry no commands and cannot authorize execution.

ObservationSecretScan.description: Typed proof that every inline Observer input passed the bounded Secret Scan before provider access.

ObservationPromptInjectionScan.description: Typed proof that the exact bounded untrusted Observer input was scanned for prompt-injection instructions before provider access.

ObservationDataEgressPolicy.description: Closed no-egress policy for the one-shot Observer model call.

ObservationSnippet.description: One explicitly bounded untrusted source fragment; full files and logs are excluded.

ObservationUntrustedInput.description: Only bounded untrusted material permitted in an Observer request. Patch bytes, full source, raw logs, secrets, and Artifact bodies are excluded.

ObservationIntent.description: Fail-closed Observer intent bound to one exact applied result and a pre-scanned bounded untrusted input.

ObservationRequest.description: One strict, non-streaming Observer request. The runtime may issue at most one model open for this identity.

ObservationResponse.description: Strict one-shot Observer JSON response; every property is required and unknown properties are rejected.

ObservationReceipt.description: Exact durable Observer receipt. It contains bounded model output and digests, never prompts, source, logs, or secret values.

RepairEnvelope.description: Bounded repair input. Source snippets and diagnostics are content-addressed Artifact references, never inline bytes.

ChangeBatchReceipt.description: Terminal apply receipt for one ChangeBatch. Exact terminal states bind base and result Git trees plus the exact delta; an uncertain state forbids result claims.

ChangeBatchProposalEvent.description: Codex poll event carrying one canonical bounded ChangeBatch proposal.

ChangeBatchProgressEvent.description: Ordered bounded progress event for one ChangeBatch. Sequence is strictly increased by the runtime ledger.

DiagnosticParserVersion.description: Closed parser implementation and wire-format version used to normalize one validation output.

NormalizedDiagnostic.description: Bounded normalized validation diagnostic. Display is a single-line summary; raw tool output remains an Artifact.

DiagnosticBaseline.description: Canonical bounded diagnostics observed at one exact workspace tree.

DiagnosticBaselineComparison.description: Deterministic new/resolved/unchanged comparison between two exact diagnostic baselines.

RepairLoopBudget.description: Immutable upper bounds for one repair loop. maxRepairRounds is canonically fixed at three; Observer calls, primary-model calls, tokens, cost, wall time, ChangeBatches, and serialized context bytes are audited independently.

RepairLoopCounters.description: Exact cumulative usage before one repair-loop transition. Every count is monotonic and must not exceed the matching immutable RepairLoopBudget field.

RepairLoopStopReason.description: Closed reason why the loop stopped instead of scheduling another bounded repair or continuation.

RepairLoopContextPack.description: Finite context shared by Continue and Repair for one exact applied result. contextDigest is derived from length-framed schemaVersion, identity, observedRevision, proposalDisposition, goalSummary, completed and incomplete acceptance criteria, nullable RepairEnvelope, latest receipt, nullable latest observation, and Artifact references; digest and serializedByteCount are excluded from their own digest. serializedByteCount binds the exact canonical JSON payload, capped at 131072 bytes. Complete conversation history, source files, patch bytes, raw logs, and Artifact bodies are excluded.

FinalCandidateFreezeFact.description: Sealed final-candidate fact for one accepted exact result. It binds the result Git tree and delta to the canonical receipt, optional bounded observation, bounded-loop usage, finite-context digest, and content-addressed candidate Artifact. A deterministic hard-check acceptance may freeze with finalObservation null.

DebugSessionStatus.description: Closed lifecycle state for one durable DebugProbe session.

DebugProbeKind.description: Closed family of bounded read-only probes.

ProbeSideEffectClass.description: Host-verified resource isolation class. No class grants writes to the accepted candidate workspace.

ProbeWorkspaceAccess.description: The only workspace access granted to DebugProbe execution.

ProbeNetworkAccess.description: Closed network observation scope; production mutations are never represented.

ProbeCompletionRuleKind.description: Deterministic rule used to stop one probe round without sampling the primary model per probe.

ProbeExecutionStatus.description: Closed status for one probe execution.

ProbeRoundStatus.description: Closed status for one probe round.

ProbeRoundCompletionReason.description: Closed terminal reason for one probe round.

ProbeExecutionEventKind.description: Ordered worker fact for one probe execution. These facts do not wake the primary model.

ProbeRoundEventKind.description: Ordered round fact. Only the terminal round fact is a primary-model feedback boundary.

DebugHypothesisStatus.description: Closed evidence-backed state of one debug hypothesis.

DebugExperimentStatus.description: Closed lifecycle state for one isolated ephemeral debug experiment.

DebugExperimentCleanupStatus.description: Terminal cleanup state for one isolated debug experiment.

DebugProbeRoundAuthority.description: Replay-stable authority for one probe round. Job attempt, lease fence, session, repository revision, and environment are immutable.

DebugProbeIdentity.description: Replay-stable identity for one probe. It binds the exact job attempt, lease fence, round, probe, workspace revision, and environment digest.

DebugProbeError.description: Bounded machine-readable failure retained by DebugProbe receipts.

ProbeCommandSpec.description: Bounded no-shell command definition. The host recomputes commandArgBytes from the canonical argv encoding.

ProbeResourceClaim.description: Complete resource declaration revalidated by the host before scheduling. Candidate workspace access is always read-only.

ProbeSpec.description: One bounded read-only information probe. Raw shell source, candidate writes, package installation, and undeclared resources have no contract field.

ProbeRoundBudget.description: Immutable hard limits for one probe round. The scheduler rejects a plan whose declared sum exceeds any limit.

ProbeRoundBudgetUsage.description: Audited cumulative resource use for one probe round.

ProbeCompletionRule.description: Deterministic round completion rule evaluated only by the host.

DebugProbePlan.description: Canonical bounded model output for one DebugProbe round. A round, not an individual probe, is the primary-model feedback unit.

ProbeExecutionIntent.description: Durable intent written before one probe is scheduled. Identity and spec probe IDs must match exactly.

ProbeExecutionReceipt.description: Terminal bounded receipt for one exact probe execution. Raw output is retained only through Artifact references.

ProbeRoundReceipt.description: Terminal model-feedback receipt for a whole probe round. Every nested receipt repeats the exact probe authority binding.

ProbeExecutionEvent.description: Strictly ordered probe execution fact. It is persisted and projected without triggering primary-model feedback.

ProbeRoundEvent.description: Strictly ordered round fact. The finished event is the only DebugProbe primary-model feedback boundary.

ProbeRawStream.description: Closed process stream retained as a raw content-addressed Artifact.

ProbeRawStreamEncoding.description: Exact UTF-8 decoding state of one retained raw stream. Invalid bytes remain only in the raw Artifact.

ProbeRawStreamBinding.description: One bounded raw stream binding. It contains metadata and an Artifact reference, never raw output bytes.

ProbeNormalizerVersion.description: Closed deterministic Probe Result Normalizer implementation version.

ProbeStackParserVersion.description: Closed host-selected stack parser version. Selection is part of the normalizer profile and is never inferred from output.

ProbeNormalizerProfile.description: Host-selected exact normalizer profile bound into every evidence bundle. A model probe cannot select or infer this profile.

ProbeBaselineState.description: Explicit baseline state. Missing, incompatible, or unparseable current evidence is never represented as an empty clean comparison.

ProbeBaselineEvidence.description: Exact optional diagnostic baseline comparison with explicit absence state and authority dimensions required for comparability.

ProbeBaselineSelectionState.description: Host-owned baseline selection persisted before execution. A prior bundle is never replaced by a later registry lookup during recovery.

ProbeBaselineSelection.description: Exact durable baseline choice. Prior authority fields are all present only for prior_bundle and are revalidated against canonical stored bytes.

ProbeEvidenceCompletenessStatus.description: Whether deterministic L0/L1 evidence is complete for the host-selected profile.

ProbeEvidenceIncompleteReason.description: Closed reasons that make a probe evidence bundle incomplete rather than clean.

ProbeEvidenceCompleteness.description: Explicit completeness result. Complete has no reasons; incomplete has at least one canonical reason.

ProbeStackFrame.description: One bounded canonical stack frame. At least one field is present and raw stack text remains in an Artifact. The pure evidence validator enforces the cross-field non-empty rule.

ProbeStackCluster.description: One de-duplicated stack with a deterministic digest and total occurrence count. It contains no raw stack text.

ProbeDiagnosticOccurrence.description: One unique normalized diagnostic together with its exact bounded occurrence count.

ProbeFailedTest.description: One deterministic failed-test fact projected from an existing normalized diagnostic.

ProbeWorkspaceDeltaState.description: Whether an authoritative workspace delta was captured. Pure read-only probes are not applicable rather than an ambiguous empty change set.

ProbeWorkspaceDeltaEvidence.description: Explicit workspace-delta observation state. Not-applicable requires an empty list; available is reserved for trusted host observation.

ProbeEvidenceBundle.description: Canonical durable deterministic L0/L1 evidence for one exact probe. Raw output appears only through raw stream Artifact references.

ProbeEvidenceSummary.description: Bounded bundle projection for a later round feedback boundary. It contains counts, completeness and a bundle reference, never raw logs.

HypothesisEvidenceCandidate.description: Unpolarized deterministic evidence candidate for one probe target. D3 does not assign support, contradiction, or confidence.

DebugHypothesisEvidence.description: Evidence reference bound to the exact probe authority, workspace revision, and environment.

DebugHypothesis.description: One canonical evidence-backed hypothesis projection. Supporting and contradicting evidence are append-only, disjoint and reducer-owned.

DebugConfirmedFact.description: One immutable confirmed fact derived from complete exact current-round evidence.

DebugHypothesisLedger.description: Canonical projection of the applied DebugProbe Ledger event chain. It contains bounded summaries and evidence references, never raw logs or conversation history.

DebugExperimentCleanupReceipt.description: Terminal cleanup receipt. Any residual resource makes the experiment ineligible for reuse.

DebugExperiment.description: One isolated ephemeral experiment. Its revision is never a candidate revision and cleanup is mandatory before reuse.

ReadOnlyRoleWorkspaceMode.description: Workspace modes that never grant candidate Writer authority.

ProbeReceiptStatus.description: Closed terminal status retained by one probe execution receipt.

ProbeRoundReceiptStatus.description: Closed terminal status retained by one probe round receipt.

ExecutionMode.description: Process-level Worker execution strategy persisted in runtime evidence. Selecting DebugProbe never grants candidate workspace writes.

ProbeRoundReceiptReference.description: Canonical durable reference to one exact terminal ProbeRoundReceipt. The Artifact digest binds canonical bytes; receiptDigest binds semantic fields.

DebugHypothesisEvidencePolarity.description: Explicit model disposition for one exact neutral D3 evidence candidate.

DebugHypothesisEvidenceAssessment.description: One explicit support or contradiction assessment. The reducer must match candidate target and evidence exactly against the sealed current-round D3 projection.

DebugHypothesisMutationKind.description: Closed mutation kind for one hypothesis in a current-round Ledger update.

DebugHypothesisMutation.description: Evidence-bound before/after mutation proposed for one hypothesis. The reducer owns transition, direction, target and current-round checks.

DebugReproductionRecipeStep.description: One stable ordered reproduction step. A machine probe step may bind the exact admitted probe definition digest.

DebugReproductionRecipe.description: Current bounded reproduction recipe with exact supporting evidence and stable step digests.

DebugReproductionRecipeUpdate.description: Evidence-backed replacement of the current reproduction recipe. Null at the event boundary means no recipe change.

DebugUnresolvedQuestion.description: One stable unresolved question retained without conversation history.

DebugHypothesisLedgerSeed.description: Initialization input. Every seed hypothesis must be active at zero confidence with no evidence.

DebugHypothesisLedgerUpdate.description: One model-proposed current-round update. Source receipt, context, request and previous Ledger digests form the idempotency boundary.

DebugHypothesisLedgerEventKind.description: Only applied facts enter the current Ledger chain. Prepared rounds and stale evidence use separate journals.

DebugHypothesisLedgerEvent.description: One canonical applied Ledger fact. Stale evidence is not a Ledger event and cannot advance sequence, digest or context cursor.

DebugDeltaContextEstimatorVersion.description: Frozen conservative context accounting profile: one estimated token per canonical UTF-8 byte.

DebugContextSafetyScannerVersion.description: Closed host secret-scanner rule version for DebugProbe context text.

DebugContextSafetyProfile.description: Host-owned scanner profile bound to every safe DebugProbe context payload.

DebugDeltaContextBudget.description: Immutable hard bounds and estimator policy for one DebugProbe Delta Context.

DebugContextSnippet.description: One explicitly bounded secret-scanned evidence or source fragment. Full files, full logs and conversations are excluded.

DebugHypothesisChange.description: Only the before/after hypothesis fields and exact new evidence added by one applied round.

DebugQuestionChange.description: One stable question opened or resolved by the applied round.

DebugProbeDeltaContext.description: Deterministic bounded model context for one new evidence round. It contains only changes since the nullable durable cursor, new bounded evidence summaries and candidates, questions and selected safe snippets.

DebugHypothesisRoundEvidence.description: Canonical durable current-round evidence cut used for Delta preparation, model assessment validation and exact Ledger replay.
